lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs4Sn2Bi2Cl12 (reduced formula Cs2SnBiCl6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Sn each adopt octahedral coordination by six Cl atoms, while Cs centers have eight Cl neighbors. The same analysis finds corner-sharing between Bi and Sn octahedra, and both edge- and face-sharing between Cs and Bi or Cs and Sn polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
